messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — we're scheduling the v1 -> v2 API deprecation banner for next week. Need owners for: snippet updates, migration guide edits, and smoke tests. Short thread to assign.

Liam O'Connor: I can take the Node + Python SDK snippet swaps. Quick Q: do we prefer to show the new `model` alias or the full `model_id` pattern in examples?

Anya Patel: @Liam O'Connor go with `model` alias for simple quickstarts, but include a one-line note showing `model_id` for prod examples. That prevents churn in small apps.

Rob Ellis: I'll own the docs page that lists breaking changes (docs/migrate/v1-to-v2.md). Plan: add a small "why" at top, then a table of diffs and a migration checklist.

Maria Chen: Great. @Rob Ellis, can you add an explicit snippet for the streaming change? People trip over the param rename.

Rob Ellis: Yep. Example I'll add (to be reviewed):
```
// v1 streaming
const res = client.stream({ path: '/v1/generate', onData: d => console.log(d) })

// v2 streaming
const res2 = client.stream({ model: 'redwood-medium', streaming: true, onDelta: d => console.log(d) })
```

Liam O'Connor: Nice. I'll mirror that in the SDK samples and add a quick migration test that asserts the `onDelta` callback fires.

Samir Rao: I'll run a link audit after PRs land. Reminder: we have a couple of internal links referencing `/v1/models` that need alias redirects. I'll open a redirect PR in infra.

Anya Patel: For snippet ownership — let's make a tiny checklist comment in each docs PR: owner, reviewer, smoke-test id. That helped last time. Also add an emoji reaction when done (:white_check_mark:).

CI-bot: deploy-checks/1764205431: created smoke-test job template: migration-smoke-176420. Assign whoever merges to kick it off.

Liam O'Connor: Added TODO note in my SDK PR: "add quickstart v2 snippet + compatibility note". @Anya Patel can you review Node sample?

Anya Patel: On it. I'll also add a one-liner about model fallback mapping (e.g., old alias -> new model) and a link to the model-swap doc.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. Final action items: Rob — docs page + streaming snippet; Liam — SDK samples + smoke tests; Anya — review + alias blurb; Samir — redirect PR; CI-bot — template ready. We'll reconvene in #docs tomorrow at 11am to confirm rollout. :rocket:
